description:
## Features

### YouTube and YouTube Music
- **Visual preferences icons:** `Bold` and `Bold (stock size)` now also thicken the back arrow and the search icon in the RVX settings toolbar, in the main screen, in every sub-screen and in the search. `Regular` and the app's own toolbar icons stay as they are.

### YouTube
- **Feed card layout:** `Dynamic card colors` also tints the recommendation cards under the player, the title area and the channel row, with the same corners and spacing as before. The player, comments and engagement panels are unchanged.

## Bug Fixes

### YouTube and YouTube Music
- **Visual preferences icons:** `Bold (stock size)` is bolder and larger, close to the weight of the app's own settings icons. Wide and tall artwork keeps a small safe margin inside its slot instead of touching the edges.
- **Visual preferences icons:** The RVX entry in YouTube Settings lines up with the stock rows (icon and label) when `Bold (stock size)` is selected. Music's branding icon keeps the native slot.
- **Visual preferences icons:** The option texts now say that icons inside the RVX sub-settings need `Apply to all settings menu` to be on, even with a bold style.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.21.1...v1.22.0)
